chunks: 2551 - And ʿAlī ibn Muyassir wrote to Abī Jaʿfar al-Thānī, peace be upon him:
Asking him about a man who performed ʿUmrah in the month of Ramadan and then came to the Hajj season: should he perform Hajj as ifrād, or perform tamattuʿ? Which of the two is better?
So he, peace be upon him, wrote: “He should perform tamattuʿ for it.”
ai.seo_question: If someone performed ʿUmrah in Ramadan and then attended the Hajj season, should he do ifrād or tamattuʿ?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a person who performed ʿUmrah in Ramadan and then reached the Hajj season. Imam Abū Jaʿfar al-Thānī عليه السلام instructs that such a person should perform Hajj al-Tamattuʿ, indicating its preference in this case.
